name: Mandate Occurrences 5
definition: Provides further details related to the duration of the mandate and the occurrence of the underlying transactions.

SequenceType.name: Sequence Type
SequenceType.definition: Identifies the underlying transaction sequence as either recurring or one-off.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Regularity with which instructions are to be created and processed.

Duration.name: Duration
Duration.definition: Length of time for which the mandate remains valid.

FirstCollectionDate.name: First Collection Date
FirstCollectionDate.definition: Date of the first collection of a direct debit as per the mandate.

FinalCollectionDate.name: Final Collection Date
FinalCollectionDate.definition: Date of the final collection of a direct debit as per the mandate.
